k13_spec.name: K1 (which margin) / K3 (field boundary) / INFERENCE FIX for the confirmed D2 host-entry effect
k13_spec.label: POST-CONFIRMATION EXPLORATORY: every fold has been opened; only K-specific coefficients unseen at freeze

common.outcome: Y_strict (W2 host d-papers by author-disjoint newcomers)
common.primary_fe_side_row: concept x e + d x e
common.offset: log(n_entry_papers) in every PPML count model
common.se: CRV1 by concept, pyfixest small-sample factor (fixef_k nested), t(G-1) CIs
common.per_sd: SD of A_cont on the retained sample of THAT fit (K1 decomposition: full co-primary retained SD)

K1.K1a_LPM_primary: OLS on Any = 1[Y_strict>=1] | concept + e + d; regressors A_cont + CT + controls + log(n_entry_papers) (offset meaningless for a probability: declared); iterated singleton pruning; effect in pp per SD
K1.K1a_logit: unconditional FE logit (IRLS, weighted within-transformation, exact sparse projection) with concept + e + d; iterated pruning of singleton and all-0/all-1 FE levels; odds ratio per SD. Deviation: pyfixest feglm not used (no FE support for logit in the pinned version is assumed; own IRLS used instead and declared)
K1.K1a_loglink: PPML on Any, same FE and regressors (log n as regressor, no offset); proportional effect on P(Y>=1) per SD
K1.K1b: PPML on subsample Y_strict >= 1, same FE, controls + CT, offset; IRR per SD; re-pruned; label 'conditional on uptake starting; descriptive, subject to selection'

decomposition.share: b_ext / (b_ext + b_int), both per SD of the FULL co-primary retained sample

K1.side_rows: primary FE (concept x e + d x e) for K1a-LPM and K1b, labelled underpowered where G < 50

K3.sample: pooled SCREEN + HELDOUT frozen samples with fold indicator
K3.model: Y_strict ~ A_cont x {Physics/Astro, CS, other} + CT + CTRL2, offset, PPML, CRV1 concept
K3.group_coding: field_group = ORIGIN field of concept (31 Physics/Astro, 17 CS, else other); constant within concept
K3.irr_per_sd: ONE common SD = SD of A_cont on the pooled retained sample
K3.wald: H0 b_phys = b_cs = b_other, 2 df, CRV1 V; p from F(2, G-1) = W/2 (chi2(2) p reported beside)
K3.focal_contrast: separate model A_cont + A_cont x Phys (1 df): b(A x Phys) = b_phys - b_rest; ratio of IRR/SD

perm.scheme: permute origin-group labels across CONCEPTS (group sizes in concepts preserved); recompute Wald W and contrast t

K3.secondary: host-field grouping (field_d: 31/17/other), group main effect absorbed by d; labelled SECONDARY
K3.mesh_row: MeSH R2 shown separately (biomedical), never pooled
K3.descriptive_rule: any group with G < 30 is descriptive and excluded from the Wald test

rand_t.scheme: permute A_cont within concept; Y, controls, FE fixed; t = b/SE_CRV1
rand_t.seed: SEED + draw (same draw index in every fold)

freedman_lane.scheme: residualise A_cont on CT + controls (+ log n for LPM) + FE by OLS; permute residual within concept; add back fitted

INFERENCE.crv1_null_rejection: share of rand-t draws with CRV1 p < 0.05 (t(G-1)); plus z SD of the draws
INFERENCE.ivw_rand: same draw index across folds; z_IVW* from per-fold b*, SE* (log IRR/SD)

checks: K3 Wald p (pyfixest fepois + own Wald from its vcov)
held-out rand-t p with 500 fresh draws, seed 777, within 2 MC SE

IVW.rule: (1.96 + 0.84) x IVW SE from per-fold simulated null SEs
exp((1.96 + 0.84) x IVW SE of log IRR/SD)

k3_phys_ratio.definition: ratio of IRR/SD (Physics/Astro over rest) = exp(contrast x pooled SD)

decision_rules_verbatim.K1: EXTENSIVE if the IVW extensive-margin effect per SD has a 95% CI excluding 0. INTENSIVE-ONLY if the extensive CI includes 0 and the intensive IRR CI excludes 1; the paper's claim is then restated as 'host-leaning entries scale uptake that starts for other reasons'. BOTH if both CIs exclude the null. UNRESOLVED otherwise, with MDEs stated.
decision_rules_verbatim.K1_clarification_added_at_freeze_not_a_c: EXTENSIVE applies when the extensive CI excludes 0 and the intensive CI includes 1. The extensive quantity is the K1a-LPM IVW row. The K1a-loglink and FE-logit rows are corroborating. If the verdict holds under the CRV1 CI but the IVW randomization-t p > 0.05, the verdict text carries '(not size-robust)'.
decision_rules_verbatim.K3: a FIELD BOUNDARY is stated only if the equality Wald test of the pre-declared groups rejects at 0.05 AND one group's CI includes 1. Otherwise: 'no detectable field boundary; the physics screen null is within sampling variation', with the MDE.
decision_rules_verbatim.K3_clarification_added_at_freeze_not_a_c: the Wald p used is the CRV1 one, and the label-permutation p is reported beside it. If they disagree at 0.05, the verdict carries '(not size-robust)'.
decision_rules_verbatim.INFERENCE: if the held-out randomization-t p exceeds 0.05, the held-out sentence reads 'borderline under size-correct inference', and the headline leans on the MeSH and IVW rows, reported with the same procedure.
decision_rules_verbatim.BREAKAGE: If a K-test breaks, it is reported as NOT RUN, and nothing is refitted after outcomes are seen.
